Map retained compiler/preprocessor/assembler/linker objects and transitive headers to exact release sources and notices, including GCC/libcpp, libbackend/libcommon, libbacktrace, libiberty and source-generator inputs.

Determine retained Emscripten JavaScript/system-library/compiler-rt/libc++/ABI objects per WASM/module and their complete third-party notices. A package-level MIT/NCSA label does not settle every incorporated component.
Resolve retained zlib inputs between the identified Emscripten 1.2.13 port and SDCC support/cpp/zlib, using linker map or trace evidence.
Capture exact Ubuntu Boost header package/source hashes, copied header closure and notices rather than relying only on the logged package version.

All installed runtime members now bind to historical bytes plus one explicit line-ending transform, and all glue changes reduce to the exact appended export. The original runtime-pack generator and complete corresponding-source assembly still lack a reproduced, immutable recipe.
Capture actual linker-selected runtime members and incorporated headers for representative generated programs; the historical 13-program image comparison does not provide that attribution.
Preserve compilerLicense.status=component-review-required and runtimeLicense.status=requires-file-level-review, including separate treatment of the five previously identified LGPL headers.
